questions.question: What does Isaiah 57 condemn the people for?
options: Neglect of the poor and the weak
Pride and the love of money

questions.question: With whom does the high and holy One who inhabits eternity dwell, according to Isaiah 57?
options: The mighty and proud, to exalt them further
The wealthy and powerful, to bless their work
The contrite and lowly in spirit, to revive them
The wise and learned, to increase their knowledge
questions.answer: The contrite and lowly in spirit, to revive them

questions.question: Isaiah 57 says there is no peace for the wicked.
I dwell in the high and holy place, and also with him who is of a contrite and lowly _____.
Peace, peace, to the far and to the _____, says the LORD.
